name: okrapdf
description: Open a local PDF parser dashboard with hover source mapping, local models, your own API keys, and ParseBench scoring.

interface.longDescription: Run npx okrapdf to open a PDF beside its parsed blocks on localhost, hover to map a block to its source, parse with local models or your own keys, and score models with ParseBench.
defaultPrompt: Open this PDF in the okraPDF dashboard
Show me which local models can parse this PDF
